description: This is a Java source file defining a Spring MVC controller named ManagerSearchController. It handles various client search and export functionalities such as default search, city-based search, region-based search, status filtering, name filtering, and options to export or print search results in PDF or CSV formats. The controller interacts with services and repositories to retrieve client data, and supports web request mapping for a management interface.

classes.name: ManagerSearchController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing client search functionalities for managers, including search filtering, PDF generation, and CSV export.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Adds status and city lists to the model for view rendering.

methods.name: defaultSearch
methods.description: Handles the default search, retrieving clients associated with the logged-in user's subordinates.

methods.name: citySearch (POST)
methods.description: Filters clients based on city name.

methods.name: citySearch (GET)
methods.description: Filters clients based on the region of the logged-in user's office.

methods.name: printSearch
methods.description: Generates a PDF of the current client list.

methods.name: exportSearch
methods.description: Exports the current client list to a CSV file.
